Onten UC962 10-in-1 Type-C Docking Station Hub

Unlock the full connectivity potential of your modern laptop or workstation with the Onten UC962 10-in-1 Type-C Docking Station Hub. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium aluminum hardware component is masterfully engineered for professionals, remote creators, and power users across Egypt who require expansive multi-port configurations, seamless media data translation, and stable daily hardware performance. It stands as the definitive choice for an advanced clutter-free desktop expansion layout configuration.

The Onten UC962 expands a single Type-C port into 10 highly efficient interface layout options. It boasts brilliant 4K HD video transmission specs for external monitors, lightning-fast USB 3.0 expansion channels, an ultra-reliable RJ45 Ethernet network port, and dedicated SD/TF memory card reader slots. Outfitted with an independent 3.5mm audio jack interface and a robust Type-C Power Delivery (PD 3.0) fast-charging input system, its durable metallic housing layout safely manages thermals during intensive tracking and high-speed multi-device operation timelines.
